packages.name: HammerwatchPlus: Quality of Life
packages.description: Small helpers: buff tooltips in the HUD, item links in chat, a Sort button in the stash, a death recap, the party's last-run stats on a town board, projectile colours for colour-blind players, waygates across the town, a second weapon set on a hotkey, Priest summons that follow you to the next floor, pets that wait outside puzzle and trap rooms, HoH1-style class Title Bonuses, gold that shows its worth, the Mm-hmm! hats, orb picker warnings, dye-pot markers on the minimap, and Shift+Click (20) or Ctrl+Click (5) at the Attribute Trainer.

packages.name: HammerwatchPlus: Co-op Play
packages.description: Party features: drop equipment for other players to pick up, Architect alterations every player can pick, and a group combo bonus when the party is in combo together.

packages.name: HammerwatchPlus: Auto Aim
packages.description: Auto aim for area skills: the targeting reticle snaps to a nearby enemy and ready skills can cast themselves. On for controllers by default, an option for mouse players.

packages.name: HammerwatchPlus: Firearms Specialist
packages.description: A new class, the Firearms Specialist: rifles, pistols and explosives, with its own skills and specializations.

packages.name: HammerwatchPlus: Fourth Specializations
packages.description: A fourth specialization for eight of the vanilla classes.

packages.name: HammerwatchPlus: HoH1 Classes
packages.description: Heroes of Hammerwatch 1 classes with their own kits, and Skill 4-6 keys.

packages.name: HammerwatchPlus: Keys and Ace Chests
packages.description: Heroes of Hammerwatch 1 style locked chests: bronze, silver, gold and the red ace chest with legendary loot, each opened with a key of its tier. Keys drop from enemies; the exit guard sells keys and up to eight more bag slots.

packages.name: HammerwatchPlus: The Forsaken Tower
packages.description: A portal in town that starts the Forsaken Tower: an 18-floor campaign through the Mines, Prison, Armory, Archives, Chambers and Battlements of Heroes of Hammerwatch 1, rebuilt with Heroes of Hammerwatch 2 themes and bosses.

packages.name: HammerwatchPlus: Challenge Modes
packages.description: Opt-in ways to play: HoH1's mercenary mode (a fresh character enlists at level 10 and climbs the ranks) and a wave arena survival mode started from a statue in town.

packages.name: HammerwatchPlus: Dungeon Loot and Encounters
packages.description: New things on run floors: the puzzle rooms and HoH1's Constellation puzzle, locked loot vaults and exit switches, strongboxes, abyss cracks, three more map layouts, twelve endgame weapons, HoH1 trinket sets, valuables worth twice their gold, and Rare and Epic items that can roll a second suffix and prefix.

packages.name: HammerwatchPlus: Town Life
packages.description: Fishing and farming, the gambler, a roulette table and three more tavern levels.

packages.name: HammerwatchPlus: Pets
packages.description: Pet levels and skills, pet dyes and pickup toggles; pets wait outside puzzle and trap rooms.

all_in_one.name: HammerwatchPlus: All
all_in_one.description: Every HammerwatchPlus package in one. The packages are inside it: there is no need to enable them as well.

config.title: Abyss cracks
config.about: Some floors get a crack that spills waves of enemies, then pays out loot.

settings.title: Crack chance
settings.about: The share of floors that get a crack.

settings.title: Waves
settings.about: How many waves a crack spills before it pays out.

settings.title: Wave size
settings.about: Enemies in the first wave; each later wave adds one.

settings.title: More per player
settings.about: Extra enemies a wave gets for each player.

config.title: Extra affixes
config.about: Rare and Epic items may roll a second suffix, Epic items a second prefix. Items keep theirs when it is off.

settings.title: Extra affix chance
settings.about: The chance of a second suffix, and of a second prefix on an Epic item.

config.title: Architect
config.about: Everyone can pick and pay for alterations; adds challenges and pick presets.

settings.title: Share host's picks
settings.about: The host's alterations are paid by the whole party, in equal shares.

settings.title: Confirm NG+ start
settings.about: Starting a run on New Game+ asks first.

config.title: Attribute point clicks
config.about: At the Attribute Trainer, Shift+Click places 20 points and Ctrl+Click 5.

config.title: Auto aim
config.about: Aims, fires and casts reticle skills at enemies for you; controller by default.

settings.about: Off, on for a controller, or on for a controller and the mouse.
How far from where you aim an enemy can be and still be picked.
The skill fires once the reticle is on an enemy.
A ready AOE skill casts itself at an enemy when your mana allows.

settings.title: Auto skill delay
settings.about: The least time between two auto skill casts.

config.title: Buff tooltips
config.about: Hover a buff icon to see its name, what it does and the time it has left.

settings.title: Class buff icons
settings.about: Class skill buffs the game shows no icon for, such as War Cry, get one on the buff bar.

config.title: The Forsaken Tower
config.about: A town portal to the HoH1 campaign; HoH1 traps, teleporters and confusion in runs.

settings.title: HoH1 content
settings.about: Use the imported HoH1 levels, pets and art. Off: HoH2 stand-ins everywhere, safe with players who lack the import.

settings.title: Both tower versions
settings.about: With the HoH1 import, the portal also lists the HoH2-theme tower.

settings.title: HoH1 traps
settings.about: HoH1's traps (spike, poison, frost and drain plates, glyphs, wall shooters, turrets, stalactites, falling bricks, bear traps), each with a warning, picked by the floor's theme, on the trap map's floors and in the Forsaken Tower.

settings.title: Trap map
settings.about: The one map whose floors get HoH1 traps. The Forsaken Tower always has them.

settings.title: Trap density
settings.about: How many traps a floor gets, against the usual count.

settings.title: Teleporters
settings.about: One teleporter pad on each generated indoor floor.

settings.title: Confusion
settings.about: Eyes, confusion glyphs and confusion plates turn your movement around.

settings.title: Eye confusion
settings.about: The chance an eye's hit confuses you.

config.title: Chat item links
config.about: An item you link (hold the context key on it) is also posted in chat.

config.title: HoH1 classes
config.about: HoH1 classes (parked for now) and Skill 4-6 keys. Off: new characters can't pick them.

config.title: Colors
config.about: Projectiles tinted by team, and every player in their own color on the maps.

settings.about: Friend and foe projectile colors, with presets for color blindness.

settings.title: Projectile markers
settings.about: A ring in the team's color around every projectile, so friend and foe read at a glance.
The game's player colors on the maps, or a colorblind-safe set.

settings.title: Names on maps
settings.about: Other players' names on the maps when they are far from you.

settings.title: Name distance
settings.about: Names show for players farther than this from you.

config.title: Death recap
config.about: When you die, a panel of what hit you; when a boss dies, the party's damage.

settings.title: Chat summaries
settings.about: A chat line for every death and boss kill in the party.

settings.title: Boss recap
settings.about: The party's damage panel and chat lines when a boss dies.

settings.title: Boss panel time
settings.about: How long the boss recap panel stays up.

settings.title: Panel collapsed
settings.about: The death panel shows only its total line. Click its title to switch.

config.title: Drop trade
config.about: A key drops inventory items for friends; the use key picks up items first.

settings.about: Drops the hovered item.

settings.title: Pickup first
settings.about: The use key picks up an item before it talks to an NPC there.

config.title: Farming
config.about: Town crops, the well, herbs and wild plots in runs. Off keeps your farm saved.

settings.title: Plant in town fields
settings.about: Plots use the town's own fields; off lays out a separate row of plots.

settings.title: Wild plot chance
settings.about: The chance a run floor has a wild plot to harvest.

config.title: Firearms Specialist
config.about: The Firearms Specialist class. Off: new characters can't pick it; yours keep playing.

config.title: Fishing
config.about: The coast, the pirate and run fishing holes. Off keeps your fish and gear saved.

settings.title: Coast and pirate
settings.about: The coast's fishing spots, crab traps and the pirate in town.

settings.title: Run hole chance
settings.about: The chance a run gets a fishing hole on its first floor (Luck raises it).

settings.title: Casts per hole
settings.about: Catches each player gets at a run's fishing hole.

settings.title: Hits to land
settings.about: Hits in the green a bite takes. By fish: 2 for 1-star fish, 3 for 2-star, 4 for 3-star. 1 is one press, as before.

settings.title: Keys from catches
settings.about: Catches can bring up a key now and then.
Eats the hovered fish.

config.title: Gambler
config.about: The tavern's gambler and his bet tokens. Off keeps the tokens; fish sell for gold.

config.title: Gold worth
config.about: Gold on the floor shows what it is worth: bronze, silver and gold coins and piles.
config.always_on: Data only: it replaces the gold pickup's looks.

config.title: Group combo
config.about: Players in combo together get a group buff; boxes and vases can drop a combo orb.

settings.title: Combo orb chance
settings.about: How often a box, barrel, sack or vase drops a combo orb, before Luck.

settings.title: Orb chance cap
settings.about: The most the breaker's Luck can raise the combo orb chance to.

config.title: Keys and ace chests
config.about: Reward chests lock and want a key; ace chests pay legendaries. Off: chests open freely.

settings.title: Locked chests
settings.about: The share of reward chests that lock.

settings.title: Key drops
settings.about: Keys a floor drops, as a share of its locked chests.

settings.title: Ace chests
settings.about: The share of gold chests that become ace chests.

settings.title: Ace legendaries
settings.about: The chance an ace chest pays a legendary rather than an epic.

settings.title: Boss keys
settings.about: The chance a floor's first boss drops a key.

settings.title: Bronze key price
settings.about: What the exit guard asks for a bronze key.

settings.title: Silver key price
settings.about: What the exit guard asks for a silver key.

settings.title: Gold key price
settings.about: What the exit guard asks for a gold key.

settings.title: Ace key price
settings.about: What the exit guard asks for an ace key.

config.title: Last run stats
config.about: A notice board by the town fountain shows the party's last run statistics.

config.title: Title bonuses
config.about: One buff icon lists your hero title bonuses; the Guild Hall lists every class.

config.title: Map icons
config.about: Marks things on the minimap the game does not, such as dye pots.

settings.title: Dye pots
settings.about: A dye-pot marker over every dye bucket of the floor.

config.title: Maps
config.about: Three more layouts for the map drops: Goblin Warrens, Sunken Dungeon, High Court.

config.title: Mercenary
config.about: HoH1 mercenary mode: death is permanent, prestige ranks give more gold and XP.

settings.title: Start level
settings.about: The level a new mercenary starts at.

settings.title: Veteran level
settings.about: Enlisting needs another hero of the class at this level.

settings.title: Revivable
settings.about: A mercenary falls only when the run fails, so a revive saves it.

config.title: Mm-hmm! hats
config.about: Some rare and epic hats have their wearer say a shopkeeper's mm-hmm! at their best moments.

settings.title: Hats with it
settings.about: The share of rare and epic hats that get it. Hats that have it keep it.

settings.title: On every crit
settings.about: Also on every critical hit of the wearer, not only the big moments.

config.title: Floor objectives
config.about: Floors get a locked vault with its switch, and an exit that opens from a switch.

settings.title: Vaults per floor
settings.about: Locked loot vaults on each floor, each with its own switch.

settings.title: Exit switch
settings.about: The way down stays sealed until you find and press its switch.

config.title: Orb warnings
config.about: The orb picker shows which orbs a pick makes unavailable.

config.title: Improved behavior
config.about: Your pet waits outside puzzle and trap rooms, so it leaves buttons and pressure plates alone, and walks back out if it ends up in one.

settings.title: Room distance
settings.about: How close to a puzzle or to traps counts as in the room.

config.title: Pets
config.about: Pet levels, skills, pickups and dyes. Off: vanilla pets; their progress stays saved.

settings.title: Feeding bowl
settings.about: A feeding bowl in town that opens the same pet menu as the Pet Shop keeper.

settings.title: Pet courier
settings.about: In a run, hand bag items to your pet (Send home in the bag) and it takes them to your town stash.

settings.title: Courier trip
settings.about: How long the pet is away on a courier trip, 10 % shorter per Fetch rank.
Sends the hovered item home with your pet.

config.title: Puzzle rooms
config.about: Puzzle rooms return to the dungeons, with HoH1's Constellation among the puzzles.

settings.title: Room chance
settings.about: The share of floors that get a puzzle room.

settings.title: Constellation odds
settings.about: The Constellation's weight; each vanilla puzzle has 10, 0 never picks it.

settings.title: Summons wait outside
settings.about: Your summons stay outside while you solve a puzzle.

settings.title: Hold distance
settings.about: How near a puzzle's buttons counts as inside the puzzle.

config.title: Roulette
config.about: The roulette wheel in town. Off refunds the chips and takes the wheel away.

settings.title: Max stake
settings.about: The most gold one player can have on the table in a round.

config.title: 4th specializations
config.about: Eight new specs for the vanilla classes. Off: not offered at the picker; taken ones stay.

config.title: Stash sort
config.about: A Sort button on the town stash orders the open tab by class, type and level.

config.title: Strongboxes
config.about: Some floors get a strongbox: open it, beat the pack it calls, take the loot.

settings.title: Strongbox chance
settings.about: The share of floors that get a strongbox.

settings.title: Pack size
settings.about: Enemies a strongbox calls for one player.

settings.title: More per player
settings.about: Extra pack enemies for each player.

settings.title: Elite chance
settings.about: The chance the pack brings an elite along.

config.title: Lasting summons
config.about: Your summons follow you to the next floor, with the HP they had.

settings.title: Forgemaster risen
settings.about: The Devil Forgemaster's risen come along too.

settings.title: Every summon
settings.about: Every saveable summon comes along (wolves, minions), not only Crusaders.

config.title: Tavern
config.about: More food and drink slots at levels 4 to 6. Off: vanilla slots, levels stay built.

config.title: Trinkets
config.about: HoH1 trinkets and sets, vanilla set changes, and trinket bonuses that grow with NG+.

settings.title: NG+ scaling
settings.about: Flat trinket bonuses grow with each NG+ level of the run.

config.title: Valuables
config.about: Valuables (vases, gems, goblets) pay more gold when you pick them up.

settings.title: Gold multiplier
settings.about: Each valuable's gold, times its vanilla price.

config.title: Wave arena
config.about: A statue in town starts a survival arena; each champion kill raises your rank.

config.title: Way gates
config.about: Teleport gates in the town square and at every building you have built.

config.title: Weapons
config.about: Twelve extra endgame weapons join the drops. Off: no new ones drop; yours keep working.

settings.title: Drop weight
settings.about: How often they drop next to a base weapon of the same kind.

config.title: Wep. swap
config.about: A second weapon set you swap to with a key (X by default) or a controller button (D-pad left), in a 2 s channel.
